description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractMappingStrategies' that implements common functionality for mapping strategies within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter context. It includes methods for managing mappings, extracting headers, checking response statuses, and deriving Thing IDs from adaptables.

classes.name: AbstractMappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for mapping strategies, including managing mappings, extracting headers, status checks, and ID derivation.

methods.name: AbstractMappingStrategies
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mapping strategies map, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieves a specific mapping strategy for a given type, or null if none exists.

methods.name: dittoHeadersFrom
methods.description: Extracts Ditto headers from a given Adaptable message.

methods.name: isCreated
methods.description: Checks if the provided Adaptable is a response with an HTTP 'Created' status.

methods.name: thingIdFrom
methods.description: Derives a ThingId from the provided Adaptable's topic path.
